class.name: StreamingAssetsServer
class.brief_description: Finds the streaming assets of the running game and serves them through the [code]streaming://[/code] path prefix.

method.name: expand_template
method.description: Expands the placeholders of [member ProjectSettings.filesystem/streaming_assets/target_folder] and [member ProjectSettings.filesystem/streaming_assets/pack_file]. The export plugin and the runtime use this method, so that both arrive at the same folder: - [code]{exe_name}[/code]: [param exe_name], the base name of the executable without its extension; - [code]{app_name}[/code]: [member ProjectSettings.application/config/name], made safe for file names, or [param exe_name] if the name is empty; - [code]{version}[/code]: [member ProjectSettings.application/config/version], made safe for file names. Other placeholders are left unchanged. [codeblock] print(StreamingAssetsServer.expand_template("{exe_name}_Data/StreamingAssets", "MyGame")) # Prints "MyGame_Data/StreamingAssets". [/codeblock]

method.name: get_exe_name
method.description: Returns the [code]{exe_name}[/code] of the running game: the base name of the executable without its extension ([code]MyGame[/code] for [code]MyGame.exe[/code] or [code]MyGame.x86_64[/code]). Inside a macOS app bundle, it is the name of the bundle ([code]MyGame[/code] for [code]MyGame.app[/code]), because the binary inside the bundle may be named differently.

method.name: get_fallback
method.description: Returns the value of [member ProjectSettings.filesystem/streaming_assets/fallback] that was read at startup.

method.name: get_location
method.description: Returns where the streaming assets are on this run. [constant LOCATION_NONE] if the feature is disabled or the files are not shipped.

method.name: get_mode
method.description: Returns the value of [member ProjectSettings.filesystem/streaming_assets/mode] that was read at startup.

method.name: get_os_path
method.description: Returns the absolute OS path of [param streaming_path], for code that can't read through [FileAccess], such as native libraries or video players that open files themselves. [param streaming_path] is a [code]streaming://[/code] path or a path relative to the streaming assets folder. Returns an empty string if the files have no OS path on this run ([constant LOCATION_EMBEDDED], [constant LOCATION_PACK] and [constant LOCATION_NONE], for example on Android and the Web), if the path uses another prefix or if it leaves the folder with [code]..[/code].

method.name: get_root
method.description: Returns the folder behind [code]streaming://[/code]: an absolute OS path for [constant LOCATION_EXTERNAL_FOLDER] and [constant LOCATION_BUNDLE], the [code]res://[/code] source folder for [constant LOCATION_SOURCE_FOLDER], [constant LOCATION_EMBEDDED] and [constant LOCATION_PACK], and an empty string for [constant LOCATION_NONE].

method.name: get_source_folder
method.description: Returns the [code]res://[/code] folder of the project that holds the streaming assets, without a trailing slash. This is [member ProjectSettings.filesystem/streaming_assets/source_folder], or [code]"res://streaming_assets"[/code] if the setting is not a folder below [code]res://[/code].

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member ProjectSettings.filesystem/streaming_assets/enabled] was on at startup.

constants.constant: The files are shipped unchanged in a folder and read through [code]streaming://[/code].
The folder is shipped as a second pack, mounted at startup. The files keep their [code]res://[/code] paths.
Where there is no external folder or pack, the files stay in the main pack.
Where there is no external folder or pack, the files are not shipped.
The editor or a game run from the editor: [code]streaming://[/code] points to the source folder of the project.
A folder next to the executable (Windows, Linux), or the folder given with [code]--streaming-assets-path=[/code].
A folder inside the bundle resources (macOS, iOS).
The copy of the source folder inside the main pack (Android, the Web, or a missing folder with the [code]Embed[/code] fallback). There is no OS path.
The streaming pack, mounted at startup. Its files are below the source folder in [code]res://[/code]. There is no OS path.
The feature is disabled, or the files are not shipped on this platform. [code]streaming://[/code] is not available.
